8a8e2c91-f8b5-4025-ab4f-ecae780c78ca.description: Droid Sans Fallback is a sans-serif typeface designed by Steve Matteson for Ascender Corporation as part of the Droid font family, originally commissioned by Google for the Android operating system. It was released in 2007. The primary purpose of the 'Fallback' variant is to provide extensive character coverage, particularly for East Asian languages (Chinese, Japanese, Korean), within the same visual style as Droid Sans. This makes it a functional 'fallback' font for user interfaces and electronic communication, ensuring text is displayed even when the primary font lacks the necessary glyphs. Its design is a humanist sans-serif, prioritizing clarity and readability on screens. The font is distributed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

5ad49327-2ddd-4746-93e3-b98fb9eaf779.description: WenQuanYi Micro Hei is a free and open-source sans-serif typeface designed for screen display and user interfaces. It was developed as part of the WenQuanYi project, a Chinese open-source font initiative. The font combines the glyph structures of the Droid Sans and Hei Ti (黑体) styles, aiming to provide high readability at small sizes on digital screens. It supports a wide range of characters including Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese Kana, and Latin alphabets. The design emphasizes clarity and legibility for electronic communication, making it suitable for UI design, web content, and mobile applications.

0bf7c810-4938-4389-9c95-8a850a223c54.description: LXGW Neo XiHei（霞鹜新晰黑）是一款基于 IPAex Gothic（日本 IPA 字体）改造的中文开源黑体字体，由开发者 lxgw 维护。其核心设计理念是为清晰而生，通过简化部分部件的出脚设计，优化了字形结构，提升了在屏幕和印刷品上的阅读清晰度。该字体收录了超过2.2万个汉字，覆盖通用规范汉字表、GB/T 2312-1980等标准，并支持易经八卦、麻将、中国象棋等文化符号，以及希腊字母、西里尔字母和越南语拉丁字。字体依照 IPA 开放字体授权条款 1.0 版发布，允许免费商业使用和二次开发。
